text: かみんしつで　やすんで　いったら？

structure.jp: やすんで　いったら？
structure.en: why not rest before you go?

patterns.name: 〜たらどう
patterns.explanation: A verb with たら and a rising voice is a friendly suggestion, with どう 'how about' left out. やすんで いったら？ = 'why don't you rest before going?'

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.span: やすんで　いったら
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus いく means doing that thing first and then going on your way. やすんで いく = 'rest and then go'.
